'''Michael Rogers''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[2000 UK National Championship]] on 2 April 2000 with Throne Room Mains, according to Alex Tennet's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d733">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-12-naboo-national-championship-2000d733/ naboo-national-championship-2000], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 12 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-12-naboo-national-championship-2000d733/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
